rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The Working Committee resolution dated 24 August 2020 takes note of a letter 'of Congress President, Smt. Sonia Gandhi' and, in its Hindi text, requests Smt. Sonia Gandhi to lead in the dignified post of President (अध्यक्षा) of the Indian National Congress until the next session of the All India Congress Committee is called during the Corona period.
